pairs: Respondens autem Job Domino,
Then Job, responding to the Lord,
dixit:
said:
Scio quia omnia potes,
I know that you are able to do all things,
et nulla te latet cogitatio.
and that no thoughts are hidden from you.
Quis est iste qui celat consilium absque scientia?
So, who is it that would disguise a lack of knowledge as counsel?
ideo insipienter locutus sum,
Therefore, I have been speaking foolishly,
et quæ ultra modum excederent scientiam meam.
about things whose measure exceeds my knowledge.
Audi,
Listen,
et ego loquar:
and I will speak.
interrogabo te,
I will question you,
et responde mihi.
and you may answer me.
Auditu auris audivi te:
By paying attention with the ear,
nunc autem oculus meus videt te.
I have heard you, but now my eye sees you.
Idcirco ipse me reprehendo,
Therefore,
et ago pœnitentiam in favilla
I find myself reprehensible,
et cinere.
and I will do penance in embers and ashes.
Postquam autem locutus est Dominus verba hæc ad Job,
But after the Lord had finished speaking these words to Job,
dixit ad Eliphaz Themanitem:
he said to Eliphaz the Themanite:
Iratus est furor meus in te,
My wrath has been kindled against you,
et in duos amicos tuos,
and against your two friends,
quoniam non estis locuti coram me rectum,
because you have not been speaking correctly in my eyes,
sicut servus meus Job.
as my servant Job has done.
Sumite ergo vobis septem tauros et septem arietes,
Therefore, have seven bulls and seven rams brought to you,
et ite ad servum meum Job, et offerte holocaustum pro vobis:
and go to my servant Job, and offer these as a holocaust for yourselves.
Job autem servus meus orabit pro vobis.
But also, my servant Job will pray for you;
Faciem ejus suscipiam,
I will accept his face,
ut non vobis imputetur stultitia:
so that foolishness will not be imputed to you.
neque enim locuti estis ad me recta,
For you have not been speaking correctly about me,
sicut servus meus Job.
as my servant Job has done.
Abierunt ergo Eliphaz Themanites,
So Eliphaz the Themanite,
et Baldad Suhites,
and Baldad the Suhite,
et Sophar Naamathites,
and Zophar the Naamathite departed,
et fecerunt sicut locutus fuerat Dominus ad eos:
and they did just as the Lord had spoken to them,
et suscepit Dominus faciem Job.
and the Lord accepted the face of Job.
Dominus quoque conversus est ad pœnitentiam Job,
Likewise,
cum oraret ille pro amicis suis:
the Lord was moved by the repentance of Job,
et addidit Dominus omnia quæcumque fuerant Job,
when he prayed for his friends.
duplicia.
And the Lord gave to Job twice as much as he had before.
Venerunt autem ad eum omnes fratres sui,
Yet all his brethren came to him,
et universæ sorores suæ,
and all his sisters,
et cuncti qui noverant eum prius,
and everyone who had known him before,
et comederunt cum eo panem in domo ejus:
and they ate bread with him in his house.
et moverunt super eum caput,
They also shook their heads over him and comforted him,
et consolati sunt eum super omni malo quod intulerat Dominus super eum:
because of all the bad things that God had inflicted on him.
et dederunt ei unusquisque ovem unam,
And each one of them gave him one female sheep,
et inaurem auream unam.
and one earring of gold.
Dominus autem benedixit novissimis Job magis quam principio ejus:
And the Lord blessed the latter end of Job even more than his beginning.
et facta sunt ei quatuordecim millia ovium,
And he had fourteen thousand sheep,
et sex millia camelorum,
and six thousand camels,
et mille juga boum,
and a thousand pairs of oxen,
et mille asinæ.
and a thousand she-donkeys.
Et fuerunt ei septem filii,
And he had seven sons
et tres filiæ.
and three daughters.
Et vocavit nomen unius Diem,
And he called the name of one, Daylight,
et nomen secundæ Cassiam,
and the name of the second, Cinnamon,
et nomen tertiæ Cornustibii.
and the name of the third, Horn of Cosmetics.
Non sunt autem inventæ mulieres speciosæ sicut filiæ Job in universa terra:
And, in the whole world, there were not found women so beautiful as the daughters of Job.
deditque eis pater suus hæreditatem inter fratres earum.
And so their father gave them an inheritance along with their brothers.
Vixit autem Job post hæc centum quadraginta annis,
But Job lived long after these events, for a hundred and forty years,
et vidit filios suos,
and he saw his children,
et filios filiorum suorum usque ad quartam generationem:
and his children’s children, all the way to the fourth generation,
et mortuus est senex, et plenus dierum.
and he died an old man and full of days.
